notes: 0x004a8f00 proposed cat_moShipOutlinesDraw (cat-new) is WRONG: it is the HW1 Tactical.c toLegendDraw. It is gated by 0xa75290, the same flag that gates toAllShipsDraw in smViewportRender (mrDrawTactical). It loops over ship classes, checks toClassUsed[class][8 players] (0xbb3588, 8 bytes each), draws toClassIcon[class] (0xbb3544) with primLineLoopStart2/Point3F/End2 in a halved colour (TO_IconColorFade), then fontPrints the class name from 0x4d6b70 (ShipClassToNiceStr) in 0xffff4040. Cataclysm passes and returns y. Suggested replacement: toLegendDraw (medium).

Verified table claims independently from the exe bytes. Parse table entries are {name,flags,fn}, matching the HW1 parseEntry macro: 'between'->0x46dd20 and 'maxFrequency'->0x46e130. Function-table entries are {name,fn,...}: modifyDeltaScale->0x4e2c40, setXYZScale->0x4e3be0, setOffsetArray->0x4e3cb0, modifyFramerate->0x4e3420. Script table: setDamageEvent->0x469d90. 0x46e39b pushes 0x46e2e0 as the partCreateCallbackSet callback.

pat layout checks against CET particle.h: 0x4e3be0 ORs flags (pat+0x18) with 0x40 (PART_XYZSCALE) and stores x/y/z at pat+0x24..0x2c; 0x4e3cb0 writes pat+0x48 (offsetArray); 0x4dc3a0 copies 0x72 dwords from 0x88d300 to 0xa50410.

Medium/low entries were confirmed structurally against HW1: ccLockOnTargetNow, btgZip, hmatMakeHMatFromMatAndVec, partMeshOrient, madBindingsPost, meshAlmostCurrentMaterial (the 0x4b0020-vs-0x4af790 g_NoMatSwitch selection at 3 sites) and meshSetFade. The Cataclysm-only cat_* names match the decompiled behaviour: mcpReset string xref, objective list fed by objectiveAndFleetIntelligenceCreate, sound table read as [shipType*6+i] then soundEventPlay, and a per-vertex warp helper.

btgColorVertices 0x428e60 (medium) was accepted. It copies per-vertex RGB into the trans-vertex array and is called from btgRender 0x429280. Cataclysm adds 3 random brightness-flicker bands that HW1 lacks, so medium is the right confidence.
